scope: Primitive quadratic twists of a primitive weight-2 newform, restricted to fundamental discriminants d whose conductor |d| is coprime to the base level N.

sources.author: David E. Rohrlich
sources.title: Galois theory, elliptic curves, and root numbers
sources.pinpoint: PDF pp. 28-29; printed pp. 337-338; Proposition 10 and the immediately following Corollary
sources.statement: If the conductor ideals N(E) and N(tau) are relatively prime, Proposition 10 gives W(E,tau)=sign(det(tau))*det(tau)(N(E))*W(E)^dim(tau). Its corollary gives W(E^chi)=sign(chi)*chi(N(E))*W(E) for quadratic chi of conductor relatively prime to N(E).
sources.role: Primary theorem source for the elliptic-curve root-number formula.

sources.author: Brian Conrey
sources.title: Families of L-functions and 1-level densities
sources.publication: Recent Perspectives in Random Matrix Theory and Number Theory (2005), 225-250
sources.pinpoint: Author PDF p. 11, Section 3.3, equation (19); character conventions on author PDF p. 5, Section 2.3
sources.statement: For a primitive form f of weight k and level N and a primitive real quadratic character chi_d of conductor |d| with gcd(N,|d|)=1, the twist has level N*d^2 and xi_f(s,chi_d)=(|d|*sqrt(N)/(2*pi))^s*Gamma(s+(k-1)/2)*L_f(s,chi_d)=w_f*chi_d(-N)*xi_f(1-s,chi_d).
sources.role: Primary newform source for level, gamma normalization, and the exact functional-equation sign.

classical_weight_2_translation.note: The classical completion differs from Conrey's unitary completion after S=s+1/2 only by an S-independent positive factor, so the sign is unchanged.

character_conventions.parameter: d is a positive or negative fundamental discriminant
character_conventions.character: chi_d(n)=(d/n), the primitive Kronecker character of conductor |d|
character_conventions.parity: chi_d(-1)=+1 for d>0 and -1 for d<0; equivalently chi_d(-1)=sign(d)

finite_rule.d_positive: ROOT_NUMBER_PLUS on residues and ROOT_NUMBER_MINUS on nonresidues modulo 11
finite_rule.d_negative: ROOT_NUMBER_MINUS on residues and ROOT_NUMBER_PLUS on nonresidues modulo 11

specialization_11_a2.conditionality: The partition arithmetic is exact conditional on the imported theorem and the manifest's LMFDB identification/conductor/base-sign metadata.

exclusions_and_caveats: The formula in this manifest is invoked only when gcd(d,N)=1. If a prime divides both d and N, local correction factors are required and chi_d(-N)=0 is not a root number.
The parameter d must be a fundamental discriminant. A nonfundamental twist parameter must first be replaced by the fundamental discriminant of its primitive quadratic character.
Even fundamental discriminants are allowed here because 2 does not divide N=11; the Kronecker convention, not an odd-only Legendre convention, governs chi_d at 2.
The covariance prime set omits the base bad prime 11. At primes p dividing d, chi_d(p)=0 is retained exactly in the finite character rows.
No rank, central order, zero, or parity conclusion is drawn from a functional-equation sign.
No finite covariance table is asserted to imply an asymptotic law.
